title: Last Sloop Masterpiece by Alloy Yachts Now Available: Performance Cruiser Encore Changes CA
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Last Sloop Masterpiece by Alloy Yachts Now Available: Performance Cruiser Encore Changes CA
summary: A unique maritime opportunity has emerged as the Alloy Yachts' last sloop creation, the renowned 'Encore', is now listed for sale.
body: Once upon a 2013 launch, the Encore sloop set sail from the docks of the acclaimed Alloy Yachts, marking the completion of the shipyard's final sloop project in New Zealand. This sailer, a custom-made performance cruiser, swiftly tossed its striker in the ever-shifting winds of maritime prowess, setting itself apart as an all-rounder with a reputation to boot. With a single owner and captain bring her ladle to stern since her maiden voyage, the Encore has showcased her worth with luxuriant grace and sporting clout.

Upgrades? Encore laughs in the face of the mundane, embracing a philosophy of continuous enhancement that saw a significant investment in 2023, culminating in the furling of new sails in 2024. Adopting an 'open cheque book policy,' her stewardship is one marked by an unflinching commitment to unparalleled excellence.

Beyond state-of-the-art hardware, it's in the realm of interiors that Encore really sings. Housing up to nine guests across four sumptuous cabins, she dons the cloak of ambassador for lavish hosts. A full-beam master suite with a private en suite serves as the centrepiece, while dedicated space accommodates a hardworking crew of six across three cabins.

The Encore welcomes her guests with a warm embrace, as they enter an atmosphere of sophistication and ease. This blend of modernity with classical elegance culminates in an expansive, relaxed living space that ensures guests can savour the sea's infinite vistas through large, inviting windows. An impeccably designed galley gives a nod to versatility, equally suited to casual feasts as it is to formal entertaining.

To step aboard the Encore is to witness first-hand the craftsmanship of Dubois Naval Architects. Her seamless integration of a low-profile deckhouse with a streamlined hull and graceful sheerlines is a nautical poem crafted in metal. The spacious deck seems to gently cradle the sea below, offering peace, tranquility and the comfort of hidden speakers for a perfect symphony of relaxation.

Perhaps the cherry on top, Encore is generously self-sustaining, able to cruise autonomously for up to six months - making her the epitome of adventurous luxury. With a freezing capacity, tankage, and storage to match a range of 4,000 nautical miles, this sloop challenges the bravest of explorers to envision their aquatic narratives. And for those ready to pen their own seafaring epic, the Encore waits, proudly displaying her price tag of $17,500,000.

title: Taking the Dubai International Boat Show by Storm: The 101m Superyacht 'Lily' from the Creative Powerhouses Oceanco and Vripack
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Taking the Dubai International Boat Show by Storm: The 101m Superyacht 'Lily' from the Creative Powerhouses Oceanco and Vripack
summary: Oceanco, the renowned Dutch boat builder, in collaboration with the boundary-pushing Vripack, captivates the nautical world with the dazzling 101-meter superyacht 'Lily'.
body: The celebrated Dutch manufacturer Oceanco, in conjunction with their Netherlands counterpart, Vripack, has taken the nautical world by storm with the unveiling of their latest opulent creation, the 'Lily'. This 101-meter superyacht, part of Oceanco's Beyond Custom series, floats majestically, creating an imposing sight on the water. Unearthed at the 2025 Dubai International Boat Show, 'Lily' encapsulates a fusion of innovation, luxury, and sophistication. As its name implies, the design of this vessel draws heavily on the natural world, evoking images of lilypads that emerge from the water by day and retreat by evening. The asymmetric bow design, walkaround decks, and a spacious heliport testify to the ingenious craftsmanship of Vripack. Cavernous storage space for four tenders and a helicopter further emphasizes the imposing scale of this maritime marvel. Fashioned for 'visionaries and trailblazers', this yacht features large windows, interior glass, and boasts a generous 5,600GT. This results in a breathtaking visual impact with extended sight lines and unexpected delightful vantage points. The unique features that characterise this yacht offer an innovative amalgamation of function and aesthetics. With overlapping decks and exquisite sculptural architecture, enabled through pioneering monocoque construction, this vessel is centered around an open plan design aimed at maximizing space and creating an uninhibited flow throughout. Augmenting its majestic charm, the top deck hosts a dedicated owner's private sanctuary, a luxurious apartment complete with a terrace that offers an unobstructed, panoramic view traditionally reserved for the bridge. Oceanco and Vripack's 'Lily' is undoubtedly a spectacular tribute to the marvels of modern nautical design. Evocative of ambition, it beckons to those who dare to leave their mark on the seas.

title: Taipan of Wales: Sale of Historic 37m Pendennis Ketch Masterminded by Dubois and Disdale
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Taipan of Wales: Sale of Historic 37m Pendennis Ketch Masterminded by Dubois and Disdale
summary: The classic 37.4-metre Taipan of Wales, a symbol of effective and intricate naval architecture by Ed Dubois and Terence Disdale, has been sold successfully.
body: Taipan of Wales, a renowned bluewater performance ketch with a history as impressive as its design, has recently changed hands. Instrumental in this sale were Zancle 757, introducing the buyer, and Alastair Shove of Carrswood Yachts, representing the seller. With its impressive form dating from 1991, this 37.4-metre marvel is the work of British shipyard Pendennis.

This sailing yacht is the fruit of a unique collaboration between Ed Dubois, credited with her sophisticated naval architecture, and Terence Disdale, responsible for her luxurious interior. The entire construction is clad in aluminium, capturing a sense of timeless elegance. Over the years, this ketch has witnessed numerous refits, including a substantial deck replacement in 2015, encapsulating the allure of yesteryears in a modern aura.

The forward-facing seats in the spacious deck saloon offer a commanding view, complemented by an open lower saloon with a dining area. The catering services are facilitated by the Miele Professional equipment-studded galley and laundry. Its foredeck comes with a quick fill Jacuzzi pool, a perfect option for those seeking relaxation.

On her 4,700 nautical mile range, the vessel guarantees solid performance at sea, with a top speed of 12.5 knots and a cruising speed of 10 knots, powered by a single 543hp MTU diesel. Taipan of Wales also benefits from in-boom Reckmann furling and carbon-fibre spars installed in 2006. Other amenities include a Williams 565 DieselJet tender and Scubapro dive equipment.
This iconic sailing yacht, symbolizing the timeless charm of classic crafts, continues to create ripples in the yachting world, proving that age is just a number.

title: The Thrilling Return of the Superyacht Cup Palma in Summer 2025: Unfamiliar Grounds, Classic Rivalries
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: The Thrilling Return of the Superyacht Cup Palma in Summer 2025: Unfamiliar Grounds, Classic Rivalries
summary: The summer of 2025 is set for a riveting display of opulence and competition as the 29th Superyacht Palma Cup sets sail with a fresh location.
body: Just as summer hints its arrival in 2025, the 29th Superyacht Palma Cup sets the stage for an enthralling contest among seafaring colossi. The Cup has chosen the Club de Mar-Mallorca as its new anchor point, nudging the grand collection of yachts and their eager crews to the very heart of the event's vibrant social scene.

At the helm of this convoy is the Wally sailing yacht Rose, the 24-metre reigning champion looking for a consecutive win, a feat not accomplished since Kokomo did so in 2002. To challenge the Rose's supremacy are prestigious contenders such as the 38.8-metre Vijonara and the recently launched Linnea Aurora.

There is, however, heightened anticipation around the 35.4-metre Gelliceaux, a debutant to the Superyacht Cup and an already proven fierce competitor, emerging victorious at the 2024 St Barths Bucket.

Balin 68 Café Racers Ganesa and Open Season are among the other noteworthy entrants. With a new backdrop and an impressive line-up, the Superyacht Palma Cup 2025 promises a summer of thrill, adventure, and camaraderie on the high seas.

title: RMK Marine Breaks Ground with the Arctic 90, a Superyacht for the Extreme Adventurer
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: RMK Marine Breaks Ground with the Arctic 90, a Superyacht for the Extreme Adventurer
summary: RMK Marine, the Turkish shipyard, has unveiled the Arctic 90, a superyacht concept designed for the fearless and ambitious adventure-seekers.
body: Unveiling a trailblazer in the shape of a superyacht, RMK Marine steps into an uncharted territory of marine design. Enter the Arctic 90, their latest revelation, a 90-metre vessel designed with the audacious sea explorer in mind. Engineered specifically for severe cold, this ironclad marvel heralds a new era of nautical exploration.

Built from ‘special steel’ and reinforced with an aluminium superstructure, the Arctic 90 promises unmatched stability even in the harshest of weather conditions. It's a product of RMK Marine's partnership with ER Yacht Design, a Canadian designed studio famed for their adventurous designs including the ER65, the yard's flagship explorer. The Arctic 90’s exterior design, reminiscent of a vintage bi-colour palette, gives the vessel a retro aesthetic, distinct from its contemporaries.

The interior reflects the essence of snug practicality, realized with floor-to-ceiling glazing that naturally draws guests’ gaze to the panoramic vistas of the Antarctica or the jagged Meditteranean coastlines. The Arctic 90 is also built to Category B Ice Class and Polar Class 6 standards, exhibiting its impeccable resilience.

Breaking down the specifics, the Arctic 90 boasts a 14.5-metre beam, a draft of 4.5 metres, and a volume of under 5,000GT. RMK Marine continues its nautical fortnight by working on two other yachts - the ER65 and the 49.9-metre Aries, the latter being a collaboration with Design Unlimited and Hot Lab. For the affluent seafarer interested in taking this beauty home, Aries is currently on sale for a cool €31,500,000 with Ocean Independence.

title: Step Inside the World's Largest Superyacht REV Ocean: An Ultra-Luxe, Environmentally-Friendly Marvel
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Step Inside the World's Largest Superyacht REV Ocean: An Ultra-Luxe, Environmentally-Friendly Marvel
summary: Uncover the plush interior of the world's grandest superyacht REV Ocean, a stunning, eco-conscious marine wonder ready to set sail in the near future.
body: The world’s largest superyacht is already inviting gasps of awe, never has vessel possessed such harmonious blend of opulence and eco-conscious design priorities. The majestic REV Ocean, measuring an impressive 194.9 metres, has just unveiled its sumptuous interior renderings, courtesy of the yacht's central agency for charter, Burgess. This announcement comes in quick succession to exciting news that this high-profile vessel will soon depart from its construction site, Vard's facilities in Norway, setting sail towards the Netherlands. Here, the vessel will be meticulously outfitted over the coming 15 to 18 months at Damen Shiprepair Vlissingen.

Once it’s complete, REV Ocean plans to spend a quarter of its time chartering. The rest of the time? The yacht will moonlight as a platform for delivering science projects specifically designed to foster marine conservation efforts. Interestingly, the charter fees accumulated from these explorations will supplement REV Ocean's scientific work and philanthropic endeavours.

Not just a yacht, REV Ocean is Kjell Inge Røkke's sea-faring dream. The owner and accomplished Norwegian businessman envisions the yacht’s future as a 'platform for gathering knowledge', welcoming researchers, environmental groups, and educational institutions on board to identify innovative solutions to challenges associated with our seas.

Although primarily a homage to marine conservation, one cannot deny the yacht's ultra-luxe offerings. Designed with the help of the industry-renowned Espen Øino, REV Ocean features plenty of outdoor lounges, a tennis court, a swimming pool and a full-fledged spa.

Deeper beneath its glitz and glamour, you'll find advanced oceanography equipment facilitating the survey of marine areas, currents, the seabed, and the rich biodiversity of the ocean. The yacht boasts a dedicated submarine hangar, an additional science lab, and a HiPAP system to track undersea gadgets. Equipped with an on-board metal shop and a state-of-the-art 3D printing facility, the team hits to the high seas with a level of self-sufficiency unparalleled in marine explorations.

Committing itself to liveliness, REV Ocean will feature a media room for hosting live-streamed podcasts and interviews. Its team is already in dialogue with documentary filmmakers from esteemed platforms such as Netflix and Disney. As REV Ocean CEO Nina Jensen teases, expect enlightening and inspiring conversations from notable personalities aboard the vessel.

To top it all off, the REV Ocean has been designed with an acute environmental consciousness. Boasting a fuel-efficient design, the yacht will include an energy recovery rudder system, medium speed engines, diesel-electric propulsion and an exhaust cleaning system. As we build our anticipation for its scheduled Q4 2026 delivery, it’s clear the REV Ocean represents a new era for superyachts: one where luxury, conservation and adventure seamlessly coincide.

title: Rare Beauty at Sea: Sokny, the Exquisite Navetta 37 Yacht, is Now Up for Grabs
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Rare Beauty at Sea: Sokny, the Exquisite Navetta 37 Yacht, is Now Up for Grabs
summary: One of Custom Line's coveted Navetta 37 yacht, Sokny, has hit the market. Promising untapped luxury, this is a chance not to be missed.
body: Emanating elegance and imbued with grandeur, the rare Navetta 37 yacht, Sokny, has been unfurled as a majestic embodiment of nautical magnificence. She is the shimmering gem among the few select yachts produced by the esteemed Ferretti Group's Custom Line. Delivered in 2022, Sokny beams in mint condition courtesy of her recent refurbishment, which includes a stunning new paint job from this year.

Moulded in the expertise and creative might of Zuccon International Project and Ferretti Engineering Department, Sokny is a marvel sprung from the blueprints of design prodigies. The rhythm and essence of her interiors have been exquisitely inked by the Odone International Design Studio, culminating in a stunningly luxurious arrangement.
The spacious body, boosted by an 8-metre beam and 289 GT, is a sanctuary of deluxe furnishings and fashionable decor, dotted with vibrant colours, abstract art, and a hint of bohemian chic.

External expanses are no less inviting, boasting an assortment of decks teeming with plush seating and dining options. From the main deck to the upper deck and the sun deck, each accommodation aligns with the ethos of luxury. Relax at the jacuzzi, enjoy your drink at the bar, bask in the sun, or dine under the stars in these palatial provisions.

Propelled by powerful twin MAN engines, Sokny sails proudly with a top speed of 16.8 knots and offers serene cruising at 12.5 knots. The inclusion of electro-hydraulic stabilising fins assures a smooth sail. For those who seek even more comfort, there are optional gyroscopic stabilisers.
Listing at €16,750,000 VAT paid, Sokny offers a glimpse into the extravagant world of yachting. A rare find indeed, she is the paragon waiting for her discerning suitor.

title: The 79m Turquoise Superyacht Originally Named Project Toro Discloses its New Identity as Nympheas
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: The 79m Turquoise Superyacht Originally Named Project Toro Discloses its New Identity as Nympheas
summary: The Turkish boatyard has finally delivered Project Toro, a superyacht of unmatched size and grandeur, now christened Nympheas.
body: There's a new gem in the crystal waters of the sea, and it's the 79-meter Turquoise superyacht, a vision of modern-day luxury. Previously known as Project Toro, the chic maritime beast has now been christened Nympheas, embracing Greek roots that signify water lilies and grace. The baton of its journey has been passed from the Pendik shipyard in Turkey to Dürres in Albania, marking its first voyage under its new moniker. This towering, resplendent craft stands as the largest yacht built by the honored Turkish shipyard to date, sold by SuperYachtsMonaco in 2021.

A peek behind the scenes reveals Nympheas' elegant two-toned exterior and a beach club equipped with side opening platforms. Her hull, cloaked in gold, had earlier this year made the journey from Turquoise's facility in Kocaeli to Pendik, the glamorous destination where her outfitting works have come to life.

One might think Nympheas is nothing short of a floating city, considering its grandeur. With an 8.5-meter swimming pool and a semi-submerged Neptune lounge onboard, it brings a slice of paradise to the sea. Perfectly tailored for guest comfort and formidable service levels, the interior layout boasts seven guest cabins and an owner's suite, lodging for 21 crew members, setting a gold standard for onboard luxury living.

This nautical achievement follows the news of Project Arrow, Turquoise's first hybrid build, being transferred to Pendik for interior works. Nympheas is the tangible result of Turquoise's pursuit of 'pushing boundaries,' a beacon that points towards a future where battery-powered hybrid propulsion systems may just become the new normal.

As the world awaits more from Turquoise, the 79m superyacht Nympheas primes herself to journey across the sea, a testament to the fearless innovation and timeless elegance that characterizes today's maritime luxury era.

title: Isaac Burrough Design Unleashes Stratos, a Ground-breaking Superyacht Concept Inspired by Automotive Design Aesthetics
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Isaac Burrough Design Unleashes Stratos, a Ground-breaking Superyacht Concept Inspired by Automotive Design Aesthetics
summary: New Zealand-based Isaac Burrough Design reveals 'Stratos', a thrilling 80m superyacht concept, redefining the convergence of luxury sea travel and automotive design.
body: Dive deep into a world where the boundaries of luxury yachting and innovative design seamlessly blend, introducing 'Stratos', the latest superyacht concept from Isaac Burrough Design. Hailing from New Zealand, this powerhouse design studio is pushing the envelope with their ground-breaking 80m concept that promises an inimitable sea experience. With an unapologetically bold and modern form that draws its inspiration from sleek automotive designs, Stratos defines itself with its sculptural curves and dramatic proportions.

Stratos breaks traditional norms, focusing her top deck on technical areas, the bridge, and her 21 dedicated crew members, while the lower decks are reserved for unlimited guest enjoyment, accommodating up to 12 guests. Its forward-facing owner's suite, nestled behind the foredeck, features private deck access and breathtaking panoramic views.

The yacht's innovative features do not end here. From a stern beach club that extends 150 square meters to a glass-bottomed pool situated above the swim platform, Stratos weaves in mesmerising aquatic sights and reflections into its design. Isaac Burrough, the genius behind this design, leverages the 'sleek, sculptural forms of automotive design' to both turn heads and maintain a timeless elegance that keeps Stratos as relevant today as it will be tomorrow. The concept images eloquently illustrate this compelling combination of light, form, and surface, setting new expectations for modern yacht design.

title: Fabbro Yachts' Pioneering F115 Trideck: A Nautical Masterpiece Marking New Heights in Luxury Sailing
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Fabbro Yachts' Pioneering F115 Trideck: A Nautical Masterpiece Marking New Heights in Luxury Sailing
summary: The resplendently avant-garde F115 Trideck from Fabbro Yachts emerges grandly onto the brokerage market, utterly revolutionising the art of luxury yachting.
body: With a dynamic blend of high technology, elite craftsmanship, and visionary aesthetics, Fabbro Yachts reveals the enchanting F115 Trideck superyacht; a breathtaking sight poised to chart new waters in the arena of luxury sailing. The vessel, the first in the esteemed Turkish shipyard's F115 series, has joined the ranks of the brokerage market, given voice through the skilled brokerage of Dimitri Blaimer and Kutsal Coban of IYC.

A major standout feature is the generosity in physical space, as a staggering two metres of headroom spreads liberally across all three of her decks, thus giving a sense of openness and volume throughout her interiors. Her main saloon, formal dining room, and an al fresco lounge are precisely arranged in an open plan architecture on the main deck. An expansive dual-level beach club lends another allure. The interaction with nature is promoted with a subtle elegance as stairs lead up to an extended swim platform, seamlessly complemented by sun loungers and a garage.

On the bridge deck, guests are taken further into the lap of luxury with a sky lounge and an alfresco dining area catering to twelve. Up on the sundeck, one finds partial shade, a sit-up bar, and a spacious fixed sunpad. All these combine to create an atmosphere of elegant leisure and sublime exclusivity, all under the sky and surrounded by undulating wave rhythms. The F115 is not only a testament to luxurious design but it is also cut from the cloth of advanced technology with twin 1,182 hp MAN engines offering a cruising range of 4,100 nautical miles at a comfortable speed of 10 knots.

title: Exemplifying European Craftsmanship and American Design, Lürssen's Motor Yacht Envy Makes a Comeback
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Exemplifying European Craftsmanship and American Design, Lürssen's Motor Yacht Envy Makes a Comeback
summary: The Lürssen's iconic motor yacht, Envy, known for its perfect blend of European build and American interior design, makes its comeback to the brokerage market.
body: A heady cocktail of European craftsmanship infused with an American flavor, the Lürssen's Envy yacht is a sight to behold. Sculpted to perfection by the renowned German shipyard in 1996, the yacht recently returned to the brokerage market, showcasing the high-quality aluminum construction that is a testimony to its pedigree origins. Overseen by Drettmann Yachts, this majestic work of art now awaits the discerning appraisal of potential patrons.

Envy owes its charismatic exterior to Beiderbeck Designs while its ultramodern interiors were brought to life by Patrick Knowles and Birgit Schnaase. The yacht underwent a full refurbishment in 2005 with its latest enhancements completed as recently as 2018. The present asking price for this beauty is €5,900,000, with VAT duly paid.

In addition to its luxurious quarters, Envy boasts a saloon that perfectly merges comfort and style with two opulent sofas and a dining table that can host ten guests. A spiral staircase leads to the upper levels that house a snug saloon with a bar. The sundeck is an undeniable highlight of the yacht with its own lounge area and a bar. But the real showstopper is the aft deck that transforms into an al fresco cinema under the open sky.

Twin 3,484hp MTU engines give the yacht a noteworthy range of 1,600 nautical miles at 10 knots and deliver a top speed of 21 knots. The cruise speed stands at a steady 11 knots for extended journeys. The yacht has been rigorously maintained under Bureau Veritas class standards, promising safety and unwavering quality. So, if luxury and performance are what you seek, the Lürssen's Envy awaits your discerning eye.

title: Palmer Johnson's mesmerizing marvel, the 43m motor yacht Lady J, experiences a sizable price cut.
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Palmer Johnson's mesmerizing marvel, the 43m motor yacht Lady J, experiences a sizable price cut.
summary: Luxury yacht Lady J, crafted by American builder Palmer Johnson, undergoes a $500,000 reduction in price.
body: A picture of waterfront opulence, the scintillating 43-meter Palmer Johnson motor yacht Lady J is making waves in the yachting market. Substantially setting back its price by a further half-million dollars, it has got connoisseurs in quite the frenzy. As exquisite as it gets, this metallic wonder is listed for sale with Wes Sanford and Mike Finnegan of Northrop & Johnson.

Casting a form entirely in aluminium by the esteemed American yard Palmer Johnson, Lady J sports a captivating exterior courtesy of artist Tom Fexas. This creative genius was keenly involved, not just in concocting the enchanting exterior but also in collaborating with the shipyard for the firm naval architecture. Flawless as a swan, Lady J has seen its fair share of refurbishing since it first sailed in 1997, with the last in the line being 2021. The latter refit was the replacement of its main engines and transmissions.

On the outside, Lady J's skylounge aft flaunts an al fresco dining area and settees around the deck’s edge. More fun awaits with a Jacuzzi, a bar and sunpads on the sundeck. The yacht for sale also impresses with an array of water toys and snorkeling gear. Housing twin Detroit diesel engines that guarantee a top speed of 17 knots and cruising speed of 12 knots, Lady J is more than just a pretty face.

Currently moored in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, Lady J is awaiting the right owner – someone captivated by her distinctive charm and mesmerising beauty. A yacht for those who adore the finer things in life, Lady J is ready to write new chapters in her compelling narrative.

title: 60m Lürssen Motor Yacht Bella Vita Gets a $3M Discount
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: 60m Lürssen Motor Yacht Bella Vita Gets a $3M Discount
summary: A $3 million slash hits the price of the exquisite 60-metre Bella Vita superyacht, making it an even more irresistible prospect for the discerning buyer.
body: In an astounding deviation from its once-hefty price tag, the 60-metre Lürssen superyacht Bella Vita is now taking on the tides with a $3 million discount. This stunning news follows just two months after a previous $5 million chop. Joint agents Merle Wood and Associates, alongside the esteemed Vladimir Tupikov from Eastwind Yachts, are spearheading the sale for this high-seas marvel. They're doing so with fresh confidence now that her price is a more digestible $49,500,000. \The iridescent Bella Vita boasts an exceptional pedigree with her full build carried out by the renowned German yard Lürssen, whilst the renowned Espen Øino worked her design magic. She was initially launched in 2010 as Katie Sue II, but has since undergone extensive refits in 2021 and 2024 to ensure she remains synonymous with luxury. Glade Johnson’s interior design speaks volumes in classy arts with her handcrafted woods, juxtaposition of fabrics and clever lighting throughout. \ Fit to house 12 guests in six generous double cabins that feature king-size beds, the Bella Vita leaves no stone unturned when it comes to comfort and luxury. The full-beam master suite is on the main deck whilst the VIP stateroom adds an extra layer of panache to the bridge deck. Bella Vita further offers four guest cabins on the lower deck, all with en suite bathrooms and the latest entertainment systems. \Another enticing feature is Bella Vita's plethora of amenities, which make her an ideal yacht for both relaxation and entertainment. From a sundeck flaunting a bar, lounge, and Jacuzzi to a gym fully equipped with cardio machines and free weights, there's no shortage of areas to unwind. For those of a more party-oriented nature, a full disco with laser lights, DJ mixing decks and a smoke machine are also part of the recipe. \ Functionality isn’t neglected in the Bella Vita. She is powered by robust twin Caterpillar 3512B engines, delivering a cruising speed of 12 knots. A study in elegance, speed and convenience, Bella Vita is patiently lying in West Palm Beach, Florida hoping an astute seafarer might strike an attractive deal for her. To the ones in pursuit of luxury sails, Bella Vita is just about ready to ship off.

title: Set Sail in Luxury: Sanlorenzo's Iconic Kamakasa Yacht Secures a Well-Heeled Buyer
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Set Sail in Luxury: Sanlorenzo's Iconic Kamakasa Yacht Secures a Well-Heeled Buyer
summary: In a sailing world buzzing with grand acquisitions, the Sanlorenzo motor yacht Kamakasa stands apart, attracting a thrilling new buyer.
body: Delighting nautical connoisseurs worldwide, the grand 44.5-metre Sanlorenzo motor yacht Kamakasa has found her new harbinger. Boomer Jousma of the Italian Yacht Group and Tony Maggio of SI Yachts played pivotal roles as seller and buyer representatives respectively, orchestrating this momentous sale.

Luxury doesn't come more compelling than Kamakasa, the proud second hull of the acclaimed Sanlorenzo 44 Alloy series. Built in aluminium under the expert eye of Zuccon International Project and delicately delivered in 2020, this yacht showcases a jaw-dropping blend of engineering and aesthetic finesse. Acclaimed as a new-build marvel in 2018, Kamakasa's recent sale marks her elevation to a distinguished third owner since inception.

The yacht's novel design ensures seamless access between the aft deck, bow and flybridge, with the flybridge presenting as one of the largest in its category. A contemporary interior style brings together white-hued furniture and light-grained marble, punctuated by contrasting elements like rich wood panelling and shimmering black bulkheads. Kamakasa's intricate design caters innovatively to leisure with a generous foredeck, a versatile beach club styled as a bar, lounge and gym, and a unique facility to store a seven-meter tender.

Propelled by twin 2,636hp MTU diesel engines, Kamakasa's prowess on water is commendable, boasting a maximum speed of 21 knots, cruising speed of 18 knots and a staggering range of 2,000 nautical miles. Further boosting her stability at anchor and aboard, zero speed stabilisers are inbuilt in this luxurious yacht. Now under the patronage of an elite new owner, the extravagant yacht proudly sails under the price tag of $22,900,000.

title: Alamshar: The Aga Khan IV’s Former Superyacht Offered at a Remarkable Discount
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Alamshar: The Aga Khan IV’s Former Superyacht Offered at a Remarkable Discount
summary: A resplendent jewel in the yachting world, the 50m motor yacht formerly belonging to the Aga Khan IV, has seen a substantial price reduction.
body: Alamshar, the imposing Devonport motor yacht, is now in the market at a substantially discounted rate. This unique yacht is a bastion of pedigree and prestige, originally built by her former owner, none other than the late Prince Karim Al-Husseini, also widely recognized as the Aga Khan IV. A spiritual guide and co-founder of the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda, the Prince’s yacht was designed for ultimate luxury.

The 49.9-meter long vessel was delivered in 2014 as a marvel of modern engineering. She is the only yacht in the world powered entirely by gas turbine, capable of reaching speeds exceeding 45 knots. Built in aluminium and carbon fibre composite, her exterior bears the prestigious imprint of Donald L. Blount's design and naval architecture.

Several areas throughout the vessel invite socializing, relaxing and entertaining. Large, curved sofas in the spacious salon, a games table, desk, and a formal dining room all contribute to the tasteful opulence. Natural light from curved windows illuminates a generous office situated on the main deck.

The functionality of the yacht does not end with luxury accommodations. Private sunpads are easily accessible via ladders on each side of the upper deck, and additional crew accommodations are available in five cabins. This majestic vessel, once part of the Aga Khan’s illustrious life, is ready to find her new owner, set sail and write the next chapter of her extraordinary journey.

title: Lürssen's Enigmatic Superyacht Ace 21 Nimbly Emerges from Its Cocoon
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Lürssen's Enigmatic Superyacht Ace 21 Nimbly Emerges from Its Cocoon
summary: Lürssen's once-under-wraps build, the imposing 78m yacht Ace 21, has broken cover, tantalising onlookers with her sleek lines and secretive, yet lavish design.
body: Emerging in a blaze of intrigue from its shed in Lemwerder, Germany, the Lürssen-built superyacht Ace 21 has been sighted for the first time. Straddling the line between alluring secrecy and tantalising revelation, this 78-metre colossus was briefly transported between halls at the shipyard, preparing for the final stage of works anticipated for completion this year.

Ace 21, initially spotted in 2023 during her hull's outfitting, has let slip bits of her design puzzle, featuring five decks marked by sterility and modernity, coupled with a stalwart plumb bow. While the architects remain unannounced, Ace 21 shows off a steel and aluminium structure powered with diesel propulsion, engendered with 2,500GT volume that testifies to Lürssen's design gravitas.

Lürssen's reputation was only polished further with its delivery in the previous year of the hard-to-nail 142.1-metre superyacht Dragonfly. Designed to stun, Dragonfly was fitted with cut-above features comprising a glass-bottom pool on the main deck, an exquisite spa, a state-of-the-art cinema, and a vibrant water sports centre, among many other splendid amenities.

As the effortlessly stylish Ace 21 prepares to sail into the sunset later this year, luxury yacht enthusiasts everywhere wait with baited breath for this mysterious vessel's final reveal. Much like deciphering a cryptic novel, the beauty of the secretive Ace 21 lies not only in the revealed, but also in the concealed.

title: Unveiling the rich interiors of Baglietto's 35-metre superyacht DOM 115: A study in Italian elegance
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Unveiling the rich interiors of Baglietto's 35-metre superyacht DOM 115: A study in Italian elegance
summary: Italian shipbuilder Baglietto reveals a tantalizing peek at the interior design of its first DOM 115 Yacht model: a testament to luxury and style.
body: The intoxicating blend of 'la dolce vita' and sailing has found its epitome in the superyacht model, DOM 115 by famed Italian shipyard Baglietto. The yacht's interiors are a masterpiece of design, offering both exquisite comfort and Italian signature style.

Suffused with a warm, yet understated aesthetic, the DOM 115 creates a cosy enclave at sea. The well-curated materials include cashmere fabrics for a gentle caress, untreated Tuscan leathers lending an old-world charm, and the gleaming light of Carrara marble in the bathrooms for a distinctive mark of Italian luxury.

In its practical design and configuration, the DOM 115 can accommodate up to 12 guests in five cabins along with a crew of seven, proficiently providing the opulent comforts of home away from home, even while sailing. The aft deck lounge joins the formal dining area inside, a testament to the DOM 115's commitment to creating well-connected spaces.

The twin MAN V8 engines of the DOM 115 offer a top speed of 14.5 knots, infusing the tranquility of sailing with a dash of thrill. Dom 115 is clearly a small but significant step in this direction, offering an unabashed celebration of the joys of sailing in an icon of Italian luxury.
Shaping dreams into reality, the next domineering and elegant DOM115 is already being prepped, expected to be ready to rule the seas by March 2026.

title: The Elite Hybrid of Air and Sea Transportation: How eVTOLs are Set to Revolutionise the Superyacht Experience
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: The Elite Hybrid of Air and Sea Transportation: How eVTOLs are Set to Revolutionise the Superyacht Experience
summary: Meet the latest innovation to hit the superyacht scene - electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft, promising luxurious, rapid and refreshing travel experiences.
body: Luxury, convenience, and privacy - these are the hallmarks of the illustrious superyacht industry. Steadily adopting innovative transportation solutions, it is now setting sight on possibly the grandest yet: the electric vertical take-off landing aircraft or eVTOL. These runway-independent, full-electric chariots of the sky have a synergy with luxury yachts that promises to transform superyacht access.\ Transporting owners and guests from urban clutter, remote terrain, or the unsteady shores to an anchored or cruising yacht, eVTOLs spell the future of seafaring elitism. Insurance and operational challenges aside, the pressing issues are regulatory and safety-related. None of the world's governments have certified passenger services for hire via eVTOLs, though parallels can be drawn to helicopter landing facilities on yachts. Surprisingly, an eVTOL, accommodating passengers and luggage, weighs far less than a helicopter, thereby streamlining deck requirements.\ First-generation eVTOLs will feature pilots, but also a suite of in-flight sensors and advanced software for obstacle detection and avoidance. This offers enhanced safety measures, particularly during operation in dense urban areas or bustling ports. The ambition, however, remains to facilitate remote piloted or fully autonomous eVTOLs, requiring a web of international legislation covering licensing, safety, and controls.\ The FAA and EASA have already begun considering safety regulations for eVTOLs, outlining rules for these 'special class' aircraft. There's also an ongoing debate over jurisdiction assignments of eVTOLs to air traffic regulators over international waters, an approach similar to commercial jets being handed off to respective agencies across borders. Prospects are bright, challenges aplenty, and the era of superyachts interlaced with eVTOLs is dawning.

title: Experience Ultimate Luxury and Speed on the Water with Horizon Yachts' Newest RP122 Model
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Experience Ultimate Luxury and Speed on the Water with Horizon Yachts' Newest RP122 Model
summary: Horizon Yachts is set to make waves in the world of luxury sea travel, delivering to the U.S its latest high-performance 37.2-metre model, Miss Michelle.
body: Horizon Yachts, the renowned Taiwanese shipyard, has pushed the envelope once again, delivering their newest model, the 37.2-metre Miss Michelle, to her lucky owners in the United States. This is the ninth RP122 (raised pilothouse) model. Distinctive for her dual helm stations, the Miss Michelle also carries the signature 'high-performance, piercing bow' of Horizon's fast-displacement series, allowing her to cruise through the seas with top speeds of up to 18 knots.

The yacht provides luxurious accommodation in four cabins, including a full-beam lower deck VIP cabin and a full-beam master suite on the main deck. The master suite is accentuated by a king-sized bed with a white onyx headboard, walk-in closets, vanity, and a delightful his-and-hers mosaic en suite.

Walking through the Miss Michelle, patrons are greeted by 'pure white' interiors, accentuated with contrasting dark woods. The main saloon is a spectacle in itself, with sofa seating, a custom entertainment system, and a hidden wet bar. Formal dinners can be enjoyed in the adjacent dining area, featuring a custom walnut table under a carved-glass light shade.

The pilothouse is the yacht's nerve center, featuring a custom Stidd helm chair and a slightly elevated lounge area. A second helm station is just forward and starboard, with a six-seater 'sports bar' positioned nearby. For those looking to entertain, there's a high-gloss table and coffee machine stored neatly away to starboard on the main deck. LED television and subwoofer provide an alternative entertainment space. Other standout features include a foredeck Jacuzzi and a flybridge, complete with a projector screen for cinematic experiences beneath the stars.
With 12 more units on order or under construction, Horizon Yachts continues to redefine luxury sea travel, bringing the comforts of a posh hotel to the open seas.

title: Italian Studio Camber Yacht Design Unveils Glamorous 88m Catamaran with an Incredible 'Sky Deck' and Onboard Fashion Store
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Italian Studio Camber Yacht Design Unveils Glamorous 88m Catamaran with an Incredible 'Sky Deck' and Onboard Fashion Store
summary: Camber Yacht Design has presented their latest, highly innovative concept - an 88m catamaran with a 'sky deck' and a shop dedicated to a famed Italian fashion label.
body: Italian creatives, Camber Yacht Design, have once again captured attention with their distinctive conceptualizations. Their latest development is an audacious 88-metre catamaran construct with extraordinary features such as an exclusive 'sky deck' and a fashion store dedicated to the esteemed Italian label - Moorwins.

Positioned above the main mast, the sky deck supplies a panoramic viewpoint, accessible via a lift from the main saloon. It further reinforces Moorwins' elegant and indulgent style. As the designer Carmelo Marco Bernardi explains, Moorwins' distinctive octagonal logo shapes and volumes have been echoed throughout the design, incorporating elements of the fashion brand's glamorous collections.

In addition to the 36-metre beam, other remarkable features of the catamaran are its three colossal masts, each extending over 70 metres. The design's harmonization with the Moorwins brand is reflected even further on the upper deck, conceptualised as an alfresco amphitheatre suited for onboard fashion shows and artist performances.

The design caters to the increasing trend of luxe lifestyle paired with the allure of the high seas. As a representative from Moorwins states, 'The yachting lifestyle has always been an integral part of Moorwins.' This truly innovative design brings together the essence of style, pleasure, and the love for the ocean, dwelling on the concept of hedonism and offering an extraordinary dream for the brand's admirers.

title: Ferretti Group and University of Bologna Unveil Master's Degree in Nautical Engineering: Bridging Academia and the Yachting Industry
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Ferretti Group and University of Bologna Unveil Master's Degree in Nautical Engineering: Bridging Academia and the Yachting Industry
summary: In the cutting-edge world of the yachting industry, the Ferretti Group collaborates with the University of Bologna to offer a Master’s Degree in Nautical Engineering. This innovative venture promises to mold the future builders of fine pleasure boats.
body: The realms of luxury yachting and academia are set to intersect with an exciting new initiative. The Ferretti Group, renowned in the yachting industry, has joined forces with the prestigious University of Bologna to launch an extraordinary Master's Degree course in Nautical Engineering. The collaborative project aims to nurture budding engineers specialized in the design and production of pleasure boats, equipping them with advanced skills in strategic areas, including hydrodynamics, composite materials, and propulsion systems.

Set to be introduced at the university's Forlì satellite campus in academic year 2024-25, the initiative unites various organizations, including the Emilia-Romagna Regional Administration, Forlì Municipality, Cassa dei Risparmi di Forlì Foundation, and Romagna Chamber of Commerce. This wide-ranging collaboration symbolizes the collective striving to promote the thriving industry and the Blue Economy.

Indeed, such initiatives are critical in inspiring the new generation to aspire towards excellence and support them in their choice. With this innovative program, the Ferretti Group and the University of Bologna are poised to influence the yachting world, turning fresh talent into experienced and passionate yachting professionals.

title: Unleashing the Metallic Beast: Admiral's Super-elegant 55m Superyacht Raja² Sets Sail
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Unleashing the Metallic Beast: Admiral's Super-elegant 55m Superyacht Raja² Sets Sail
summary: Witness the grandiose launch of The Italian Sea Group's metallic gem, the 55-metre superyacht Raja², showcasing the epitome of luxury sailing.
body: A big splash has been made by The Italian Sea Group's latest marine marvel – the superyacht Raja². This 55-metre nautical jewel showcases a strikingly sporty exterior, donned in a radiant metallic paint job. The high bulwarks on her aft deck provide a tasteful shelter for a sophisticated beach club area, where guests can relax and soak up the oceanic panorama. The launch ceremony of the Raja², previously cloaked in the codename 'Project 600', was held at the Marina di Carrara headquarters. The unveiling led not only to enthusiastic applause but also instilled suspense for its prospective chartering through IYC, scheduled for later this year. The superb superyacht exudes both luxury and exclusivity, with accommodation for up to 12 privileged guests. The six-cabin layout features an owner's suite on the main deck, complete with a foldable balcony designed for maximising ocean views whilst maintaining utmost privacy. Meanwhile, marble panelling and bursts of colourful furnishings infuse a touch of vibrancy into the neutral interior palette. On the lower deck, the yacht hosts a VIP suite, two double suites, and two twin cabins, with additional quarters for a 12-member crew. A sun-drenched sundeck serves as a social hotspot, fitted with loungers, sofa seating, and a visually striking glass-walled pool. Those hunting for adventure can choose from a medley of water toys or make use of the touch-and-go helipad. Amidst these extravagances, the Raja² doesn't sacrifice speed. She is propelled by twin Caterpillar engines, capable of cruising at 16.5 knots and reaching a top speed of 18 knots. The allure of the Raja² represents the pinnacle of luxurious sailing, infusing elements of style, adventure, and practicality. Her launch promises more captivating revelations from The Italian Sea Group, with a sister yacht in the ongoing S-Force 55 series and the initial unit of the Admiral Quaranta series currently under construction. So, keep an eye on the horizon, as these superyachts are set to redefine the ocean's elegance.

title: Buyer Springs for the Seventh Model of the Mangusta Oceano 50 Series, Project Nexus
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Buyer Springs for the Seventh Model of the Mangusta Oceano 50 Series, Project Nexus
summary: A new magnate has landed themselves the coveted seventh unit from the Mangusta Oceano 50 series - a yacht known as Project Nexus.
body: Superyacht enthusiasts have a new vessel to set their sights on. Celebrated Italian shipbuilder, Overmarine, has announced a remarkable deal for the sale of the seventh unit in the illustrious Mangusta Oceano 50 series. The 49.9-metre superyacht, affectionately known as Project Nexus, boasts a design by Alberto Mancini and is set to be constructed in Overmarine's well-equipped facility in Viareggio, Italy.

Project Nexus's buyer, backed by Moran Yacht & Ship, can look forward to a stunning vessel set to be delivered in 2028. Project Nexus will join celebrated sister ships like Dokinha and Eternity, carrying forwards the legacy of the maiden Oceano 50, Alisa, which was awarded in its size category at the World Superyacht Awards in 2021.

Communal comfort goes beyond standard norms. Project Nexus has a counterflow system swimming pool ingeniously constructed from a tender garage and a sundeck replete with Jacuzzi, alfresco dining, and lounge area. A sprawling 68-square metre beach club with three terraces invigorates the yacht's sea-facing design, with a line-up for many a wonderful seafaring day.

Project Nexus balances opulence with performance. The yacht will hit waters with a maximum speed of 16 knots and promises a range of 4,500 nautical miles at a leisurely 11 knots. For others wanting to dive into the universe of Mangusta Oceano 50s, Moran Yacht & Ship is the central agency for Felicitá, the fifth hull of the series known for her blue marble and mosaic-tiled Hammam and an open-air cinema on the upper deck. For the maritime magnates, the sea holds not just adventure, but a high seas lifestyle of unparalleled luxury.

title: Lazzara Yachts Reveals Interior Design of its 31m Ultra High Volume Wonder to Launch by 2025
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Lazzara Yachts Reveals Interior Design of its 31m Ultra High Volume Wonder to Launch by 2025
summary: The first interior renderings of Lazzara's UHV 100 yacht model has been unveiled, showcasing a paradigm of opulence and pure innovation.
body: Indeed, luxurious maritime excitement is stirring. Lazzara Yachts, a US-based giant in the industry, has shared interior renders of their first UHV 100 model. This 30.5-meter-long ocular treat is currently under fabrication and promises to make waves when it launches in June 2025. The newbie is a successor to the UHV 87, debuted at the 2022 Cannes Yachting Festival, carrying the legacy of high-volume layouts forward. Designed to create visual illusions of an additional deck, UHV 100 also features a refreshing dip pool on the foredeck for those balmy afternoons at sea. The lower deck shelters four guest cabins, while the owner's cabin takes pride of place on the main deck. The surprising twist? A colossal pilot house sharing space with a full-beam saloon, connecting to the al fresco lounging and dining area on the upper deck. According to prime movers Fraser and Northrop & Johnson, this yacht model is a heavyweight champion. Touting 'the highest gross tonnage' in its size category at 225GT, approximately 260 square meters of interior elegance, and 125 square meters of exterior grandeur, UHV 100 is all set to redefine the meaning of luxury. Lazzara's executive vice president, David Galante, proudly stated that the UHV 100 outstrips many explorer yachts, with a fit and finish worthy of 70-meter superyachts. Boasting a provisional top speed of 16 knots, a cruising speed of 12 knots, and a draught of 1.8 meters, the UHV 100 is perfectly designed for shallow bay and anchorage exploration like in the Bahamas and the Caribbean, effortlessly combining high-end luxury with practical versatility. Committed to excellence, Lazzara Yachts has even engaged British studio H2 Yacht Design to orchestrate the interiors, much like the firm's magnum opus, the 45.7-meter UHV 150. Shaping the future of maritime luxury, Lazzara Yachts' UHV 100 is a ride to watch out for as it makes its entrance onto the world stage.

title: West Nautical and Albatross Tee Off for Luxury Golf Events in Scotland and Dubai
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: West Nautical and Albatross Tee Off for Luxury Golf Events in Scotland and Dubai
summary: West Nautical and Albatross Golf Holidays are forging an alliance as they sponsor two high-end golf tournaments in Scotland and Dubai for 2025, blending the luxury of golf and yachting.
body: In the captivating world of luxury sports, where blue waters meet lush greens, a new collaboration is soon to break waves. West Nautical, the connoisseurs of the superyacht world, is teaming up with Albatross Golf Holidays, a name synonymous with de luxe golf experiences. The two industry stalwarts have partnered to sponsor high-profile golf tournaments in the picturesque terrains of Scotland and the regal aura of Dubai in the year 2025.

As the year progresses, the partnership carries its momentum to the exciting cityscape of Dubai for the 'DP World Tour Final Tournament Experience Pro-Am.' This grand spectacle is a congregation of professional and amateur golfers competing amidst Dubai’s most exquisite golf courses, including the majestic Yas links, Earth Jumeirah Golf Estates, and the Majilis Emirates Golf Club. The event concludes at the famed Dubai Creek Yacht & Golf club, punctuating the perfect blend of luxury yachting and golf at its finest.

Paul Williams, West Nautical’s Client Manager, reflected his enthusiasm for the partnership with Albatross Golf Holidays, viewing this as an opportune moment to crossover luxury yachting with lavish golf vacations. On the other end, Andy Scrimshaw from Albatross echoed similar sentiments, exuding confidence that this partnership will ensure an unforgettable experience for their clients.

Albatross Golf Holidays & Events, co-owned by PGA professionals Andrew Scrimshaw and Martyn Jobling, has earned an enviable reputation for hosting leading golf holidays and events across the globe. Adding another feather to its cap, the company is gearing up to offer a unique blend of high-end yachting and golfing experiences, promising expert planning, stunning locations, and exceptional service.

title: Command the seas with the Lürssen's Five-Decked Marguerite: A Creator's Dream
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Command the seas with the Lürssen's Five-Decked Marguerite: A Creator's Dream
summary: The luxurious Lürssen's 61.2-metre Marguerite, designed for ambitious voyagers, boasts a range of impeccable features including a sprawling five deck layout.
body: Plush adventures on the high seas come to life aboard Lürssen's 61.2-metre Marguerite. A five-decked floating palace of travel and leisure, Marguerite brings to bear an impressive oceanic range of 4,400 nautical miles. Designed inside and out by the renowned British studio, Winch Design, the Marguerite stands tall and majestic, radiating an aura of nautical sophistication. Constructed initially in 2004, she's not just a nautical marvel frozen in time, but one that benefits from continual improvements, enhancements and additions. Her 2024 upgrade was a significant step forward, introducing a full repaint and advancing some of the major onboard systems, as well as a sparkling new interior makeover in 2021. On the surface, Marguerite offers a plethora of open-air amenities that enrich any oceanic voyage. A grand staircase on either side of the transom escorts travellers to the multi-deck accommodation, while teak decks underfoot add an impeccably classic touch to sprawling onboard spaces that invite entertaining and family getaways. These include a capacious split-level sundeck featuring an enclosed gym, a 10-person Jacuzzi, and lounging areas for 12 guests. Below decks, the lavish vibes continue unabated. Winch Design exploited a generous 1,444 GT of internal volume to create spacious lounging areas, the highlight of which is a magnificent salon that integrates forward-facing formal dining space and an aft-facing lounge area. The residential accommodations onboard Marguerite have been crafted to ensure exclusivity par excellence. The yacht sleeps 12 guests across six luxurious cabins, including a unique 'owner's apartment' that is stretched impressively across the full 12.3-metre beam. This suite of solace offers a refuge of luxury complete with 'his-and-her' bathrooms, walk-in dressing rooms, a dedicated office, and a private observation lounge. Separate quarters in the bow can accommodate an experienced crew of 17 members, further cementing Marguerite's status as a floating marvel of luxury and sea-faring opulence.

title: Superyacht Company Pinmar Rethinks Golf Tournament Resurgence, Emphasizes Support for New Events
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Superyacht Company Pinmar Rethinks Golf Tournament Resurgence, Emphasizes Support for New Events
summary: Pinmar, a stalwart of the superyacht industry, revises its plan to reignite its former golf tournament, instead choosing to support emerging golf events through strategic sponsorship.
body: When Pinmar's famed golf tournament drew to a close in 2019, it left a void that was swiftly filled by a new wave of industry golf events. The rise of these gatherings dotted and enlivened the superyacht industry's social calendar. Rather than risk crowding the event landscape and dwarfing the singular charm of each assembly, Pinmar fittingly concludes to augment and not compete with these events.

The decision to pivot from reinstating its own tournament to supporting the prosperous ones is reinforced by the company's first-hand experience. Remy Millott, CEO of Pinmar's parent company GYG Ltd, points out that reintroducing The Pinmar Golf could potentially impede the other tournaments' momentum. These burgeoning events have quickly ingratiated themselves into the industry calendar, championing the superyacht and affiliated charities at a high level, a mantle earlier shouldered by the former Pinmar tournament.

This year marks a landmark actually; Pinmar commemorates 50 golden years in business. Celebrations are planned to acknowledge this significant milestone and honor the collective triumph, involving staff from across Europe and the USA.

The company ascribes its success to its band of diligent professionals worldwide who've contributed significantly behind the scenes throughout these years. As it readies itself to recognize its achievements over the last 50 years, it also remembers its loyal clients and Peter Allan, the founding father of the company, saluting their unwavering trust and support, integral to its journey to the remarkable present. A pool of potential engraved in a fable of the past, Pinmar rides the wave to an even subtly promising future.

title: Revitalising Mediterranean Marina Infrastructure: An Engaging Dialogue at the Balearic Superyacht Forum
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Revitalising Mediterranean Marina Infrastructure: An Engaging Dialogue at the Balearic Superyacht Forum
summary: Fostering open dialogue to improve the Mediterranean yachting landscape, the Balearic Superyacht Forum calls for change.
body: Yearning for the spray of the sea while meandering on a luxurious yacht, the Mediterranean has long been the playground for affluent sea-lovers. Enhancing this thrilling experience, the Balearic Superyacht Forum has set its sights on changing the seascape with network-driven innovation in the marina and refit sector.

Recently, they spearheaded a survey asking for industry insights into which sectors needed positive change, improvements, or further investments. Unsurprisingly, the wave of responses was overwhelming. Almost one hundred different ideas, thoughts, and suggestions poured in. Each one, in its unique way, highlighted opportunities to elevate the maritime market and refine the services it delivers.

So far, a glimpse in the vast sea of ideas includes topics like sustainability practices in marine operations, streamlining of bureaucratic procedures through digital platforms, the development of consistent regulatory rules, enhancing waste disposal systems and modernising public ports. Enlightening discussion circles also include subjects such as specialised training for marine personnel and actively promoting a more welcoming and enjoyable atmosphere within the superyacht refurbishment process.

While the nets are still out for more ideas until the end of the month, the organisers aim to spotlight the ten most valuable topics. With a renewed sense of direction and a pontoon-full of actionable insights, the Balearic Superyacht Forum is steering the Mediterranean yachting experience towards a more refined, satisfying and sustainable future, and the ripples of change have already begun spreading.

title: Unveiling the Alarming Lack of Proper Safety Practices in Superyacht Crews and the Urgency for Change
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Unveiling the Alarming Lack of Proper Safety Practices in Superyacht Crews and the Urgency for Change
summary: Superyacht crews are overlooking basic safety procedures and the industry must address this negligence urgently to avoid catastrophic incidents.
body: An alarming case study, reported by CHIRP Maritime's Superyacht Feedback, captured an all-too-common snapshot of the superyacht world - crew members working dangerously aloft sans any visible safety gear. Photos akin to this aren't rarities, suggesting a worrying trend of non-compliance with the protocols for high-altitude work that are outlined in the vessel's Safety Management System (SMS).

These instances aren’t isolated accidents, but rather a symptom of an endemic problem within the industry. Despite the clear risks, many superyachts don’t ensure their crew members employ the necessary safety precautions. A trend, that in the worst cases, is not just ignored but also indulged to save precious moments. In reality, however, securing oneself with a safety harness is far quicker than tackling the medical aftermath of a devastating fall.

While responsibility for safety falls on all shoulders, fear of losing their job often prevents crew members from challenging orders of superior officers, even if they blatantly breach safety procedures.

In the high-stakes maritime business, one's reputation is paramount. Hence, the industry's apparent tolerance of overt displays of poor safety culture is downright alarming. This hazardous practice must not become the new standard. A transformative shift in the industry’s culture of safety isn't just a nice-to-have, it is an absolute imperative.

Boats boasting solid teamwork ethics can be a bulwark against unsafe work practices – Unified, they can challenge, rectify and prevent hazardous acts. If you are aboard a ship that lacks this crucial teamwork, CHIRP is ready to champion your cause and promote safety integrity within the superyacht community.

title: Presenting the Otam 90 HT: A Customized Superyacht with a Top Speed of 45 Knots
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Presenting the Otam 90 HT: A Customized Superyacht with a Top Speed of 45 Knots
summary: Imagine a custom 28-metre superyacht that can reach 45 knots - that's the reality with Otam's latest high-performance offering, the Otam 90 HT.
body: Picture a 28-metre long vessel - powered to indulge in the exhilaration of 45 knots, oozing an air of elegance and a bespoke identity. Captivating, isn't it? That's the allure of the Otam 90 HT, a testament to Otam's outstanding craftsmanship in producing highly customised, performance-driven yachts.

This sleek marvel, birthed from the same DNA as its predecessor, the Otam 90 GTS, makes a distinct statement with its unique main deck design. The Otam 90 HT optimises its deck space with an enclosed saloon, offering several layout options that can be transformed purposefully. So while the GTS, revered for its wide-open spaces, sets the mood for grand social gatherings, the HT variant comes across as the perfect retreat for patrons preferring a more personal, intimate experience shielded from the elements.

Crafted meticulously with Kevlar or Aramat fibre and structural bulkheads welded to the keel, the Otam 90 HT minimises vibrations and noise. This exquisite boat showcases handcrafted interiors demonstrating undisturbed attention to detail that promises lasting durability. Hence, these extraordinary yachts stand the test of time while maintaining a higher resale value, a characteristic that has resulted in a loyal customer base.

With a top speed of 46-47 knots, yacht owners get to savour the thrill of speedy voyages. Imagine having breakfast in Italy and lunch in Greece - the Otam 90 HT turns this into a reality. It provides accelerated access to preferred destinations, ensuring the journey is as thrilling as the destination itself.

Otam ensures a unique boating experience by granting clients complete autonomy to customise their boat's layout and design. This, however, means that each Otam yacht's layout must be finalised before the construction begins, guaranteeing precision-engineered, quality bulkheads. A unique process that invites clients to sketch their dream yacht alongside the shipyard, creating a masterpiece that is truly theirs.

title: Honouring His Highness Aga Khan IV: A Spiritual Leader and Revered Figure in the Yachting World
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Honouring His Highness Aga Khan IV: A Spiritual Leader and Revered Figure in the Yachting World
summary: The yachting world bids adieu to an extraordinary leader, His Highness Aga Khan IV, a man renowned for his spiritual guidance and profound impact on international sailing culture.
body: The world of yachting mourns the loss of a defining figure, His Highness Aga Khan IV, who passed away at the age of 88. Known for his spiritual leadership as the 49th Imam of the Shia Imami Ismaili Muslims, his imprint spread well beyond the confines of religion. The Swiss-born leader was a fervent enthusiast of the sea, continually advocating for the joys and thrill of sailing. In 1967, Aga Khan IV co-founded the Yacht Club Costa Smeralda (YCCS) in Porto Cervo, Sardinia, initiating a tidal wave of development in the area. His vision of showcasing Sardinia as a world-class yachting hub came to fruition under his watchful stewardship. Major international sailing events, such as the Loro Piana Superyacht Regatta and the Maxi Yacht Rolex Cup, now take place on its alluring shores, attracting breathtaking vessels from around the world. His fervour for nautical excellence extended far beyond patronage, manifesting through feats of grandeur like the commissioning of the 50-metre 'Alamshar' by Devonport Yachts. Despite facing numerous obstacles in its creation, its eventual completion in 2014 is a testament to Aga Khan IV's tenacity and the crew's unwavering dedication to realising his ambitious design. Another embodiment of his penchant for speed and design was the 47-metre Lürssen Shergar, a maritime gem named after one of his racehorses. Operating on both land and sea, it reflected his understated but keen appreciation for design and performance. Today, the yachting world remembers this spiritual leader and yachting enthusiast who journeyed beyond the call of his duty, fostering a culture of maritime excellence and continuing his legacy on the high seas.

title: How Businesses are Embracing B Corp Certification to Enhance Sustainability and Ethical Practices
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: How Businesses are Embracing B Corp Certification to Enhance Sustainability and Ethical Practices
summary: In a world increasingly sensitised to environmental concerns, businesses embrace the B Corp certification as a beacon for sustainability and ethical operation.
body: The current socio-economic climate is undergoing an unprecedented transformation. The cause célèbre is environmental sustainability and social responsibility. No longer are these aspects optional augments for businesses; they are vital constituents that align with a more responsible and impactful modus operandi.

This drive towards sustainability, fueled by shifting consumer expectations and climate change realities, is reshaping global industries. One key mechanism facilitating this change is third-party certifications like the B Corporation accreditation, serving as tangible indicators of meaningful sustainability progress. They validate enhancements across governance structures, environmental impact, and community engagement, undergirded by pillars of transparency and accountability.

The B Corp certificate is deeply entwined with the fabric of a company's operations. It caters to the trifecta of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) components, ensuring that the business is not only reducing its environmental footprint but also enhancing its stakeholder discourse. The road to B Corp recognition requires a business to score a minimum of 80 out of 200 points across five salient areas: Governance, Workers, Community, Environment and Customer.

The superyacht industry has begun to sail these sustainability waters, with British design studio RWD achieving B Corp certification in 2022. These nods to corporate eco-stewardship represent a significant leap towards a more sustainable and socially responsible future.

title: West Nautical Welcomes M/Y Almissa: Luxury and Adventure Unleashed
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: West Nautical Welcomes M/Y Almissa: Luxury and Adventure Unleashed
summary: West Nautical bids a warm welcome to the latest addition to their charter fleet, M/Y Almissa, the epitome of luxury fecundating memorable experiences.
body: Providing a canvas to paint the idyllic Adriatic escape, the esteemed West Nautical introduces its charter fleet's newest member, the M/Y Almissa. A 40m Brodotrogir masterpiece, crafted in 2017, she is the contemporary vessel designed for group getaways that shall be remembered for a lifetime. Whether a corporate retreat, an extended family reunion or a momentous festivity, Almissa is the perfect host for 40 guests.

This luxurious vessel is a seafaring paradisiac state-of-the-art navigation systems and facilities equipping guests with all imaginable comforts for their Adriatic adventure. The shimmering water, towering history, and romantic local cuisine etch Croatia into the hearts of visitors. Its stunning islands and coastal gems beckon adventurers and serenity-seekers alike towards the glamour of Hvar or the untouched beauty of Mljet National Park.

The heartbeat of Almissa, her crew, a passionate team of seven alongside a gifted chef, culminates in an exquisite on-board experience. Delicacies crafted from the freshest local produce will satiate every palate, making every meal a sensory feast.

Almissa's toybox reads as an adventurer's wish list, with jet skis, water skis, SUPS, kayaks, Seabobs, and inflatables. Zipping across crystal blue waters or discovering hidden Adriatic coves, every moment spent with Almissa is one of excitement and sheer joy.

title: Lürssen Group Navigates Troubled Waters with Bid for Ailing Nobiskrug Shipyard
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Lürssen Group Navigates Troubled Waters with Bid for Ailing Nobiskrug Shipyard
summary: Bremen-based Lürssen Group intends to chart a new course for the insolvent Nobiskrug Shipyard, through a potential acquisition.
body: What might have been a sinking ship, Nobiskrug Shipyard in Rendsburg, is now anchored firmly, with Lürssen Group at the helm. The Bremen-based firm has offered a lifeline to the insolvent shipyard by launching a bid to acquire its facilities and land.

Upon the deal's closure, Nobiskrug will chart a new course, becoming part of its neighbour, the Lürssen-Kröger shipyard. The potential acquisition is a beacon of hope in straitened times, following reports that both FSG and Nobiskrug, linked to the contentious German businessman, Lars Windhorst, had entered insolvency.

Despite financial blows attributed to mismanagement, whispers of revival for the two historical yards are on the winds. The Rönner Group from Bremerhaven has pledged to continue operating the Flensburg shipyard, while Lürssen sets its sights on Nobiskrug.

Anticipation builds as construction of the LNG-powered RoRo vessel, for the Australian shipping company SeaRoad, is set to progress at the Flensburg shipyard, under the Rönner Group's direction. Yet, due to the sizable investment backlog, operations at both yards currently remain on standby.

title: Arriving Full Sail: Melges UK Sets Course for Thrilling Year with New Products and Premier European Event
author: Old Sea Dogs

summary: British sailboat dealership Melges UK prepares for an exhilarating year, featuring product debuts and the biggest European event in their calendar.
body: One of Britain's newest sailboat operators, Melges UK, has plotted a thrilling course for the year ahead with promising new product launches and Melges' paramount European event anchoring their voyage.

Among the exciting developments, they're launching is the Melges 15, a versatile asymmetric double-handed dinghy, that is set to have its inaugural European Championship in the summer. Hosted in Dun Laoghaire, running concurrently with Ireland's major sailing event, the Volvo Dun Laoghaire Regatta, the championship is shaping up to be a heated contest with an international ensemble. Interested sailors can savor the competition, thanks to the availability of 12 charter boats from Melges UK.
Furthermore, the dealership has planned a series of 'pop-up' style one-design Melges 15 events throughout the summer with demos even available at the Melges UK office in Hamble.

Bracing for perfect storm, Melges UK introduces the Melges RIB 625C - the perfect coaching RIB, which supported Adriana Penruddocke at the Summer 2024 Games in Marseilles while representing Bermuda in the ILCA 6 Class. The RIB features a unique design that efficaciously handles waves and provides a stable, comfortable platform for coaching. Fitted standard with a Yamaha 115 HP outboard engine, the RIB commands the speed and control to match pace with high-speed skiffs and other foiling classes. Coupled with its expansive interior and generous storage, coaches are looking at a comfortable and steady day at sea.
All in all, Melges UK is shaping up to make quite the splash this year, both in terms of offering exciting new products and hosting grand sailing events.

title: Invitations Open for 58th Governor's Cup: A Riveting Contest for Under 23 Yacht Skippers
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: Invitations Open for 58th Governor's Cup: A Riveting Contest for Under 23 Yacht Skippers
summary: Balboa Yacht Club, the prestigious and globally-renowned institution, has commenced acceptance of Requests for Invitation (RFI) for the 58th Governor's Cup.
body: A gust of anticipation sweeps over the sailing realm as Balboa Yacht Club starts accepting invitations for the 58th Governor's Cup. Esteemed for its vibrant history and rigorous competition, the Governor's Cup has carved a notable niche within the global yacht racing space. The 58th edition of the event will transpire from July 29 to August 3, 2025, inviting the most adept under 23 match race skippers from around the world. RFIs can be submitted at www.govcupracing.com at the earliest, before the deadline of April 11, 2025.

The previous year's battle was a nail-biting showdown that witnessed Cole Tapper from Australia making a phenomenal comeback from a 0-2 deficit to vanquish American Jeffrey Petersen by a razor-thin margin of 3-2. While Petersen has aged out of the event, the reigning champion Tapper is set to grasp the helm, readying for another year of high-octane competition.

The regatta proudly flaunts its Grade 1 status granted in 2018. The rank reflects the event’s superior quality and draws an elite roster of participants. The championship is synonymous with the iconic 'Governor's Cup 22' sloops, which will once again dance over the waves under skilful skippers in 2025. Designed by the illustrious yacht designer Alan Andrews, these sea-worthy masterpieces thrive in wind speeds as low as 4-5 knots and as high as 18-20 knots.

A decidedly thrilling contest is on the horizon, decorously set against the backdrop of sparkling seas and the camaraderie of the brilliant young seafarers eager to steer their way to glory in the 58th Governor's Cup.

title: An Exciting Weekend of Nautical Milestones: Marking 90 Years of 18 Footer Racing on Legendary Sydney Harbour
author: Old Sea Dogs
imageAlt: An Exciting Weekend of Nautical Milestones: Marking 90 Years of 18 Footer Racing on Legendary Sydney Harbour
summary: Celebrating a sporting spectacle with a flood of nostalgia, 18 Footer Racing rings in its 90th year on the captivating waves of Sydney Harbour.
body: As the sun kissed the briny waves of Sydney Harbour, a special kind of jubilation was in the air. This was no ordinary weekend of sailing – it marked an impressive milestone, the 90th anniversary of 18 Footer Racing on Sydney's breathtakingly expansive waters.

An air of excitement was palpable. The Australian 18 Footer League, first incepted on that same harbour back in 1935, was all set to honour its rich heritage. With an aim to keep the global field of aficionados up to speed with the thrilling action, the club arranged a livestreamed spectacle, carried out with the precision of a professional commentary team.

The league's thoughtful inclusion in scheduling the starts according to craft size and speed spoke volumes about their eye for detail while honouring their storied past. As the smaller, slower boats glided through the water at 2pm, mid-size vessels followed suit at 2.30pm. The grandeur finally culminated with the majestic 18 footers at 3pm. Sponsors Shaw and Partners Financial Services matched the impressive maritime spectacle with a vibrant function at Double Bay's Steyne Park.

The celebration did not lose momentum, keeping spectators on their toes through the Balmain Cup - Super Sprint Series. As the weekend reached its zenith, the Queen of the Harbour event crowned the thriving nautical extravaganza; an unforgettable toast to nine decades of thrilling water competition. A fitting celebration of a much-loved racing tradition.

title: Showdown of a Lifetime: World's Most Southern Superyacht Regatta Is All Set To Begin

In the Pacific Cup Class, Innismara will be joined by Lion New Zealand and Steinlager. Bolstered by the presence of twenty-one industry sponsors and an array of renowned sailors, the regatta promises to celebrate New Zealand's unique sailing culture. The event is scheduled to run from February 1st to 4th in downtown Auckland, with the world regatta debut of the magnificent 81 meter Sea Eagle and the first NZ Millennium Cup appearance of the impressive Sharlou adding to the allure.

title: Boris Herrmann and Sam Davies: Navigating towards Victory in the Vendée Globe's Last Stretch
author: Old Sea Dogs

The Vendée Globe is not an ordinary race; it questions and then celebrates the spirit of adventure embodied by every sailor. A host of experienced sailors, including Kojiro Shiraishi, Jingkun Xu, and Violette Dorange, have entertained enthralling tales from across the vast expanses of the open sea. Their stories, although different, narrate a common theme: the all-consuming passion for sailing, the indomitable spirit, and the audacious pursuit of victory. An event too captivating to miss, the race has even resulted in live tracking on various platforms such as the event website and the Initiatives Coeur website. Complementing the thrilling race performance are engaging updates by nautical savants, Conrad Colman, and Oliver Heer. Together they bring to shore the spirit of the Vendée Globe, the essence of the contest, and the electrifying mood of the racing currents. As Boris Herrmann and Sam Davies sail across the final miles, the world holds its breath. It is more than a race; it's a spectacle of human resilience and unyielding spirit. In the Vendée Globe, every sailor is a victor; each departing wave a coronation of their spirit.

title: Determined Sailors to Converge for the Spectacular RS400 Eurocup, UK and Irish National Championships of 2025

Leading off the home squad are Irish champions Bob Espey and Mike Ferguson, seasoned by their recent triumph in the cutthroat RS400 Winter Series. Facing them are adversaries of equal skill, including Olympian Peter Kennedy and Steve Kane, as well as former Mirror World Champion Ross Kearney, joining forces with Andrew Vaughan.

From the green pastures of Southern Ireland, Govan Berridge, and David Coleman from Killaloe journey to the competition.
